model: All 20 tabulated STScI SM4 F606W focus planes. Bilinear interpolation with each library header grid, including y=2049 end node for chip 2 in the focus library.
selection: Choose the lowest median reduced chi square on even tiles, with plane order as tie break.
verification: Report median on untouched odd tiles and on the standard fixed PSF. Require lower odd tile median before candidate diagnostic.
